prerequisites: Attainment of the second study section, requiring at least 42 ECTS credits from the first study section.
Mastery of the Java programming language

learning_outcomes.text: Name the basic concepts and functionalities of the World Wide Web (WWW).
Describe their theoretical knowledge of modern client-side and server-side web technologies in a structured way.
Specify web pages with HTML and design the layout of the pages by using CSS.
Develop dynamic web pages by resorting to the corresponding possibilities of JavaScript.
Name essential possibilities of Bootstrap and use them to design their web pages.
Develop the backend of web applications with PHP.
Use web services and REST for defining server interfaces and develop servers with these interfaces.
Apply tools for GUI-prototyping with HTML and CSS.
Implement the GUI with the help of JavaScript.

syllabus_topics: Client-side technologies: JavaScript, Domain Object Model (DOM)
Server-side technologies: Asynchronous JavaScript and XML (AJAX)

assessment_methods.method: participation with/without success (14.2 Practical Web Technologies)

assessment_rules: Passing 14.2 (Practical Web Technologies) is a prerequisite for participating in 14.1 (Web Technologies). Successful completion of the practical course requires solving 4 practical assignments. The final grade is based on the written examination.
